messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

- [2025-03-14] standup/atlas/2025-03-14: Dependency map update: the ledger needs the auth gateway (service tokens).
- [2025-01-31] standup/atlas/2025-01-31: Atlas adopted a no-deploy Friday.
- [2025-07-21] standup/atlas/2025-07-21-2: Team Atlas has moved to the second floor.
- [2025-12-24] handover/2025-12-24-billing-api: Handover: as of today the billing service moves from the Atlas team to team Boreal. Priya walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-01-06] standup/atlas/2025-01-06: Team Atlas this year is Priya and Tomasz.
- [2026-03-17] standup/boreal/2026-03-17: Team change: Marcus leaves Boreal and joins the Atlas team, effective today. Boreal saw that the resizer's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: Team Dune owns the reporting service.
- [2025-02-06] standup/atlas/2025-02-06: Billing-api calls the ledger service for invoice postings, so treat the ledger service as a hard dependency of billing-api.
- [2025-09-26] standup/atlas/2025-09-26: For newcomers: the deploy window for the ledger service is still on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-02-13] handover/2025-02-13-feature-flags: Handover: as of today the flags service moves from team Atlas to the Cinder team. Priya walked Diego through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-10-21] standup/atlas/2025-10-21: New dependency for the billing service: the feature flag service. Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags; the reasoning is that the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09: First on-call rotation for the Atlas team goes to Tomasz.
- [2026-04-14] standup/atlas/2026-04-14: Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Atlas on-call shift from Priya today.
- [2025-07-21] standup/atlas/2025-07-21: As of today Tomasz is on Dune; Atlas loses a pair of hands.
- [2025-07-16] standup/atlas/2025-07-16: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-06-13] standup/atlas/2025-06-13: Rotation day for Atlas: Priya Raman hands the pager to Tomasz.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09: The event bus is a the Boreal team service. The Boreal team owns notifier.
- [2026-06-08] standup/atlas/2026-06-08: Reminder from team Atlas: page Priya for anything this cycle, not Marcus.
- [2025-04-04] standup/atlas/2025-04-04: Reminder from Atlas: page Tomasz Nowak for anything this cycle, not Priya.
- [2025-05-14] standup/atlas/2025-05-14: Reminder from team Atlas: page Priya for anything this cycle, not Tomasz.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: The product catalog lives with the Cinder team. Cinder owns the indexer.
- [2025-02-19] standup/atlas/2025-02-19: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Priya Raman for anything this cycle, not Tomasz. Priya Raman runs the quarterly capacity review.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: Team Ember owns the job scheduler.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer: Ownership change: the search indexer now sits with the Boreal team. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-04-10] standup/ember/2025-04-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-reporting: Ownership change: the reports pipeline now sits with team Ember. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-11-11] standup/atlas/2025-11-11: Deploy freeze for billing-api: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 (the peak season). Observation from the Atlas team: after Tuesday's deploy, search-indexer's p99 latency doubled.
- [2025-09-15] standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2: Team Boreal still owns search-indexer, in case anyone asks.
- [2026-03-17] standup/cinder/2026-03-17: Reminder: notifier is owned by team Cinder.
- [2026-04-22] handover/2026-04-22-webhooks: The webhook dispatcher has a new home: Dune. Team Atlas kept it until today.

Question: Which services does Atlas own now?

message.content: Ledger and the feature flag service.
